node scripts/rea-run.mjs pass03 02-members inspect-managed-members PixelTone.exe --json (static analysis, not target execution). Exit code 0.

Read logs/pass03/02-members.stdout.json (92754-char single-line JSON); output was truncated by the viewer, so re-parsed via a local node script and wrote a pretty-printed copy (logs/pass03/02-members.pretty.json) for paging.
Extracted and reviewed member_refs, field_accesses, selection/coverage/limitations from the members JSON via a node one-liner.
Extracted and reviewed call_edges (full method-def/member-ref call graph) from the members JSON.
Extracted method 0x06000007 (m_5558f5ab53) body detail and user_strings (empty/complete) from the members JSON.
Confirmed/created the session scratchpad directory for throwaway decoder tooling (not a task deliverable).

Wrote cil_decode.py to the scratchpad: a from-scratch ECMA-335 single-byte + 0xFE-prefixed two-byte CIL opcode decoder, plus a fat/tiny method-header parser, driven purely by reading PixelTone.exe's raw bytes at the file_offset/il_size values REA already reported. This is a read of the target file, not an execution of it.

Ran cil_decode.py against all 7 MethodDef bodies; captured full per-instruction disassembly to scratchpad/decoded_all.txt (1419 lines). Verified REA-reported il_size matched the decoded byte count for every method.

Read decoded_all.txt in chunks; manually traced the control-flow-flattening (dispatch-variable + switch + loop-back) idiom used by all 6 real methods, recovering Classify/Tone/BuildTriplet/Hash/ParseIntRange semantics by hand.

Wrote extract_strings.py to the scratchpad: automatically locates newarr(Byte)+dup/stelem.i1-populate+key+call(0x06000007) idioms in the decoded instruction stream and computes the XOR-decoded string for each, mapping each to its containing method.

Ran extract_strings.py; recovered all 11 obfuscated string literals (--help, both help lines, expected-6-arguments message, neutral/mono/warm, unknown-preset message, the composite format string, the ERROR: prefix, and integer-out-of-range) with their exact byte arrays and XOR keys.

Wrote dump_compact.py to the scratchpad: re-renders a method's decoded instructions with long byte-array-literal-construction runs collapsed to one annotated line (using the strings already recovered), to make the 1032-instruction Main method reviewable.
Ran dump_compact.py against Main (0x06000006); captured scratchpad/main_compact.txt (163 lines).

Read main_compact.txt in full; reconstructed Main's complete control flow (argc==1/--help shortcut, argc==6 gate, 5x ParseIntRange, preset validation against neutral/mono/warm, 3x Tone, 1x BuildTriplet, 1x Hash, composite-format WriteLine, ArgumentException catch path with ERROR: prefix to stderr and exit 2).

Inspected each method's raw fat/tiny header flags byte directly from the exe; found Main's header has the MoreSects bit set (and Main's and Tone's bodies have extra sections), which inspect_managed_members's exception_regions field (empty for every method) did not surface.

Decoded the fat exception-handling-clause section following Main's code bytes (file offset 5272, ECMA-335 II.25.4.6 fat clause format): one typed-catch clause, try [0x67c,0x67c+1497), handler [0xc55,0xc55+146), catch type token 0x01000008. Cross-referenced 0x01000008 against member_refs' parent_token/parent_name to confirm it names System.ArgumentException, establishing the catch is ArgumentException-specific, not a catch-all.
Captured wall-clock time immediately before writing the first complete draft of pixel_tone.py, per task instructions.
